name: keyboard
blurb: Renders an interactive computer keyboard with responsive clickable keys.
description: A visual keyboard UI with styled keys that respond to physical keyboard events and mouse clicks. Includes optional keystroke preview and audio sprite sound effects.
use_when: Visualizing keyboard input, creating interactive educational tools, or demonstrating keystroke capture in a UI.
avoid_when: Capturing actual form input — use standard HTML inputs instead. Not suitable for touch-only interfaces.
a11y: Button elements with mouse and keyboard handlers; no explicit focus management or prefers-reduced-motion guard.
